preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your OpenProject instance, e.g. https://openproject.example.com or https://community.openproject.org

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Personal API token from My Account → Access tokens. Sent as Bearer auth.

preferences.name: defaultProjectId
preferences.title: Default Project ID
preferences.description: Optional numeric project ID used as a baked filter for Search and My Work Packages. Leave empty for all projects.

preferences.name: defaultStatusFilter
preferences.title: Default Status Filter
preferences.description: Baked status filter for Search and My Work Packages

preferences.name: pageSize
preferences.title: Page Size
preferences.description: Number of results to fetch per request (1–100)
